description:
Enterprise Account Executive, Cities and Counties

Mach9 builds AI CAD software that turns 3D scans of roads, utilities, and infrastructure into engineering-ready drawings for civil engineers. We're looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to help Mach9 unlock rapid growth with cities and counties across the United States.

The Role

You'll build relationships with local government agencies, introduce AI into critical infrastructure engineering and asset management workflows, and turn initial projects into long-term partnerships. This role reports to the Head of Solutions Engineering.

As an early member of our public sector sales team, you'll have the opportunity to shape our go-to-market strategy, develop strategic accounts, and help define how local governments adopt AI to manage and modernize their infrastructure.

What You'll Do

  • You will own a territory of city and county accounts across the United States, driving new business, renewals, and expansion opportunities across public works, transportation, engineering, survey, GIS, and asset management.

  • You will build a strong pipeline through targeted outbound, referrals, industry events, engineering consultants, and inbound opportunities, partnering with our BDR team while independently sourcing a meaningful share of your business.

  • You will develop relationships with department leaders, technical stakeholders, and procurement teams, understanding their infrastructure priorities, existing workflows, budgets, and purchasing processes.

  • You will navigate local government procurement, including fiscal calendars, budget approvals, RFPs, cooperative purchasing agreements, purchase thresholds, and sole-source justifications, to identify the most effective path to a funded decision.

  • You will lead customer discovery, product demonstrations, and technical evaluations alongside our solutions engineering team, establishing clear success criteria, decision timelines, and commercial next steps.

  • You will develop compelling business cases using customer-specific metrics, including engineering productivity, project turnaround times, asset inventory costs, and outsourced service spend.

  • You will manage a high volume of opportunities simultaneously, maintaining clear next steps, strong qualification discipline, and consistent momentum throughout the sales cycle.

  • You will collaborate with engineering consultants and technology partners serving local governments, leveraging existing relationships to identify opportunities and accelerate customer adoption.

  • You will turn initial projects into broader deployments across departments, projects, and infrastructure use cases, working closely with customer success to drive adoption, renewals, and expansion.

  • You will develop territory and account plans, prioritize opportunities based on funding and purchasing timelines, maintain accurate CRM records, and deliver reliable pipeline forecasts.

  • You will collaborate closely with our BDR, solutions engineering, customer success, and leadership teams to share market insights, improve sales execution, and help build a repeatable local government sales motion.

  • You will represent Mach9 through customer visits, municipal associations, public works conferences, GIS events, and strategic partnerships including APWA and Geo Week.

  • You will use AI tools and agents to accelerate account research, budget tracking, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, follow-up, and CRM management while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and judgment.

What You Bring

  • You have 7+ years of experience as a quota-carrying, full-cycle Account Executive, including demonstrated success selling software or technical solutions into cities, counties, or other local government agencies.

  • You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets, developing new accounts, and managing multiple opportunities through complex sales cycles.

  • You understand local government organizational structures, budgeting cycles, procurement requirements, and how technology purchasing decisions are made.

  • You have experience navigating RFPs, cooperative purchasing agreements, vendor onboarding, and government contract negotiations.

  • You have successfully introduced new technologies to risk-conscious buyers, built internal champions, and guided customers through evaluations and purchasing decisions.

  • You are comfortable managing a high volume of opportunities, maintaining disciplined qualification, and consistently moving deals toward clear, actionable next steps.

  • You have demonstrated success generating your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, referrals, industry relationships, and strategic partnerships.

  • You can engage credibly with technical and operational stakeholders, understand customer workflows, and translate software capabilities into clear business outcomes.

  • You bring a founder mindset. You take ownership of your results, move with urgency, operate independently, and thrive in an environment where you are helping build the playbook.

  • You are disciplined in how you qualify opportunities, manage your pipeline, and forecast revenue. You know when to pursue an opportunity and when to walk away.

  • You communicate clearly and concisely, and you actively use AI tools to improve your productivity, research, and sales execution.

Industry experience is not required. Local government selling experience is.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cooperative purchasing contracts, usage-based pricing, or land-and-expand sales motions.

  • Experience working at an early-stage technology company and helping establish repeatable sales processes.

  • Experience working with engineering consultants, systems integrators, or technology partners serving local governments.

  • Experience with LiDAR, geospatial data, reality capture, or infrastructure engineering workflows.

Benefits

  • Equity ownership in Mach9

  • 100% employee coverage for medical, dental, and vision

  • 401(k)

  • Unlimited PTO and 8 paid holidays

  • Unlimited Cursor, ChatGPT, and Claude credits

  • Monthly team offsites (go-karting, Topgolf, and more)

How We Work

This role is remote within the United States. It includes travel to customer sites and industry events up to 35% of the time.

About Mach9

Mach9 is the AI CAD platform for civil engineering, built to expand the world's capacity to build and maintain critical infrastructure. Its software turns 3D scans into engineering-ready CAD drawings, helping teams work up to 10x faster and at one-fifth the cost. Mach9 has been used across more than 2,500 projects in all 50 states and four continents, surveying over 100,000 miles of infrastructure, including for more than 50% of America's top 10 engineering firms and some of the top investor-owned utilities.

In October 2026 we raised a $34M Series A co-led by First Round Capital and Bessemer Venture Partners. Founded by engineers from Carnegie Mellon's Robotics Institute who built systems for the physical world at Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, NASA and Google X, Mach9 is headquartered in San Francisco. Learn more at mach9.ai.

Equal Opportunity

Mach9 is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act.
